intro.text: 03:07 AM The queries are still running... (I wish I shouldn't wait all the time...)

intro.speaker: Ada
intro.text: THIS IS NO SENSE! Nobody reads these dashboards anyway SQL is just something fancy for people in suits who never actually follow the data recommendations...

intro.speaker: Ada
intro.text: I'm exhausted. My eyes are in pain.. my body feels so heavy...I'll..... I'll just close my eyes for a bit... until the queries are ready... until...

According to the medical report: Ada was found not breathing over her desk at 8:00 AM by her colleagues. There were no family, friends or cat to report the situation. The cause of her death is still under investigation, testifies said something was still running in the computer.

intro.speaker: Ada
intro.text: Grass? Fresh Air? What's happening?! What are this clothes?! Why the sky looks like a table? Why does it have so many columns?

intro.speaker: Grimoire
intro.text: Surprising right? Iseakais are real after all. Sorry, welcome to the Kingdom of Code little witch. Here the world is a database, and magic is runs by querying.

intro.speaker: Grimoire
intro.text: A Grimoire. Now listen, in this world magic must written. Every spell is a query. FANTASTIC isn't it?

intro.speaker: Ada
intro.text: I write SQL all day. How bad it can be?

intro.speaker: Grimoire
intro.text: Let's just say that your whole survival depends on this now. And because I want to see you live. Before you meet the dangers of the world, practice against this dummy.

intro.speaker: Grimoire
intro.text: Ada, you must know my pages are small only four rows can fit. When you use your spells  you must pay with your mana, but only four rows will actually be cast.

intro.speaker: Grimoire
intro.text: Never written a query? In battle, just press F3 or click GUIDE: It will show you what to write, and how to read my pages.

intro.speaker: Grimoire
intro.text: And you will learn the rest from the first thing that wants to eat you.
...What's that?! Something round and green wobbles out of the bushes: is..the ASTERISK SLIME!

battle_tip: New to SQL? Press F3 for the spell guide.
victory: The Asterisk Slime melts into a puddle of rows.
Ada: One word. LIMIT. And the page behaves.
defeat: Ada's HP hits zero. The Slime wobbles triumphantly.
Grimoire: Even the best witches overflow sometimes. Again?

knight_intro.speaker: Grimoire
knight_intro.text: LIMIT is yours, witch, used to get mana and keep casting spells. You still have to meet the guardians. The next guardian is not beaten with random spells, but with the right ones. Be wise, Witch.
The Filter Door. A castle that only allows who is worth to get in. Protected by the Guardian Sir Wherewell

knight_intro.speaker: Sir Wherewell
knight_intro.text: Stop! The Knight of the Filter is here. You won't cross my lady.

knight_intro.speaker: Sir Wherewell
knight_intro.text: Only a spell of the element...I won't tell you. Only a spell of the element I am weak to cross inside. Now get out on peace or accept a cruel destiny.

knight_intro.speaker: Ada
knight_intro.text: Oh really? Do you think I'm afraid of you? Well, let's figure it out, funny can man.

knight_intro.speaker: Grimoire
knight_intro.text: Witch Listen. He's not a cupcake, if you want to breach his defense you must find his weakness and call spells from the same type. He'll try to do the same with you, he never casts without WHERE.

knight_victory: Sir Wherewell kneels and opens the gate.
Ada: WHERE is the entrance sir? ;)
knight_defeat: Ada's HP hits zero. The Knight lowers his blade.
Grimoire: Spells that are not super-effective bounce off. Filter for his weakness.

twins_intro.text: The Archive of Twins. Two scholars share one desk, one spell book and one mana pool.

twins_intro.speaker: Archivist Quill
twins_intro.text: Welcome, witch. I am Quill, and this is my brother Ink. We are bound by a key.

twins_intro.speaker: Archivist Ink
twins_intro.text: If Quill falls, I raise him again. If I fall, he raises me. Strike one of us and it is wasted.

twins_intro.speaker: Ada
twins_intro.text: So I have to hit both of you at once? With one spell?

twins_intro.speaker: Grimoire
twins_intro.text: With one query. Look at them first: SELECT * FROM enemies. Their weakness changes every round. Then watch how they write their own queries: a JOIN puts a name beside every spell. Stuck? Type SELECT and press TAB: the faded words show the next piece of the query, and TAB takes it.

twins_victory: Quill and Ink fall together, and the key between them snaps.
Ada: JOIN. One row for each, and every spell knew its target.
twins_defeat: Quill gets up. Ink gets up. The chain glows.
Ada: Hit one and the other restores it. I need to reach both.

lich_intro.speaker: Grimoire
lich_intro.text: The twins are down, witch, and JOIN is yours. But the last guardian hides his weakness inside another layer. Today you learn to ask a question inside a question.
The Sunken Crypt. A cold place where every shelf holds a book inside another book. The candles burn blue. Something is floating in the dark.

lich_intro.speaker: Nested Lich
lich_intro.text: Welcome, little witch. My body is inside a robe, my robe is inside a shell, and my shell is inside another shell. Try to find me in there.

lich_intro.speaker: Nested Lich
lich_intro.text: I change my shell every round, and my weakness changes with it. What you read about me a minute ago is already old news.

lich_intro.speaker: Ada
lich_intro.text: So I have to ask what he is weak to AND cast the spell, in one go? Can I put a query inside another query?

lich_intro.speaker: Grimoire
lich_intro.text: You can! A SELECT inside brackets runs first, like a small question for the big one. He never casts without one. Watch his book and the rune will glow. Then type SELECT and press TAB: the faded words walk you through it, and TAB takes each piece.

lich_victory: The Nested Lich cracks open, shell after shell.
Ada: A query inside a query. That was not so scary.
lich_defeat: Ada's HP hits zero. The Lich closes his last shell.
Grimoire: His weakness changes every round. Ask the table instead of remembering it.
end_of_slice: End of the vertical slice. Thank you for playing!

count_intro.speaker: Grimoire
count_intro.text: Your runes grow, witch. You can ask for exactly what you need. But what if there are far too many of them?
The Tally Barracks. Bats hang from every rafter in neat rows, and something counts them.

count_intro.speaker: Count Aggregor
count_intro.text: Good evening. I am Count Aggregor, and I count everything. One witch. Twelve bats. Zero chances.

count_intro.speaker: Count Aggregor
count_intro.text: While any squad of mine has three or more bats, the quorum holds and nothing you cast can touch me.

count_intro.speaker: Ada
count_intro.text: Twelve bats, a four-row page... if I aim one spell at every bat, I overflow before I start.

count_intro.speaker: Grimoire
count_intro.text: Then do not count bats. Count squads. Watch his book: he never casts without GROUP BY, and his HAVING tells you when he is safe.

count_victory: Count Aggregor's abacus cracks. The tally is final.
Ada: GROUP BY. One row per squad, not per bat.
count_defeat: Ada's HP hits zero. The bats settle back on the rafters.
Grimoire: Too many rows. GROUP BY e.squad: one spell per squad.

null_intro.speaker: Grimoire
null_intro.text: Even the Lich is dust, witch. The last guardian cannot be counted. It cannot even be compared.
The Null Void. No floor, no sky, no values. Only a shape that looks a lot like you.

null_intro.speaker: NULL
null_intro.text: Hello, Ada. I am the voice that said your queries were pointless. I have been watching you since the Glade.

null_intro.speaker: NULL
null_intro.text: My hp is NULL. My element is NULL. Your = cannot find me, and your hp > 0 filters me out.

null_intro.speaker: Ada
null_intro.text: Then I cannot even aim at it. How do I hit something that has no value?

null_intro.speaker: Grimoire
null_intro.text: Look straight at the void: IS NULL, COALESCE. And it reads how you cast. Never cast the same way twice.

null_victory: NULL flickers, and for once it has a value: zero.
Ada: My queries were never pointless. Precision is power.
null_defeat: Ada's HP hits zero. NULL wears her silhouette a little better.
Grimoire: = never matches NULL. Use IS NULL, and vary your casts.
count_tip: Name a squad in your row to aim at it. F3: guide
null_tip: Spells pass through NULL. Look: IS NULL. F3: guide
